root_cause_and_implementation: ProducerAncillaryCapture wraps the already-computed indicator-stage ancillary bundle (benchmark, sector, event-risk, corporate-action contamination, price-scale-break contamination) inside EodIndicatorsComputeService::computeCaptured, and the eligibility-stage dormancy read inside EodEligibilityBuildService::dormantTickerIdSet -- both call sites unchanged in their production logic, wrapped externally exactly as C08 wrapped AdjustmentFactorSetService. Each wrap retains the full unfiltered source population (market_benchmarks/market_benchmark_bars/market_benchmark_indicators, market_data_sectors/ticker_sector_memberships, md_corporate_action_revisions/market_data_corporate_action_types/market_data_corporate_actions, market_data_trading_status_event_types/market_data_trading_status_events, md_price_scale_break_candidates/md_price_scale_break_candidate_reviews/market_data_price_scale_breaks/md_adjustment_factors, and the eod_bars window for dormancy) and independently re-derives every consumed value in pure PHP from that captured population -- a faithful line-for-line port of SectorClassificationRepository::resolveSectorContextForTickerIds, EventRiskSourceRepository::resolveEventRiskContextForTickerIds/resolveCorporateActionContaminationForTickerIds and PriceScaleBreakRepository::resolveContaminationForTickerIds, cross-checked byte-for-byte against the real result (including the real producer's post-factor-removal/held-event-merge contamination post-processing). Two of the three optional producer dependencies (sector/event-risk/benchmark) are legitimately nullable in this codebase; the capture carries an explicit per-run engaged-flags selection so a disengaged producer's trivially-empty consumed value is accepted rather than independently re-derived, and a non-empty value from a disengaged producer fails closed. Historical (replay_verify) mode is blocked from reconstructing current ancillary inputs, matching every other C1 domain. ProducerInputScope's generic producer-scope completion tracking (completeInputs) and ProducerInputCompletionManifest's per-row assertValid dispatch and producer-scope reference check both had their tracked-component whitelist widened from the C08-era four entries to include 'ancillary' -- without that, C09 could never be recognized regardless of implementation state, the same class of stale gate C08 (E030) found and fixed for event_factor. The blanket 'ancillary.full_revision_contract_not_implemented' stub is removed entirely (both event_factor and ancillary stubs are now gone; nothing remains in that placeholder list). A dedicated real-data integration test (not disengaged) seeds an actual sector membership for a real listing and proves the captured sector_contexts resolves RESOLVED_AUTHORITATIVE with the correct sector_code, that the whole-C1 manifest reports zero 'ancillary.' gaps for that valid capture, and that a damaged consumed field is caught by assertValid (P86). The existing full pipeline integration suite (57 pre-existing cases, all using disengaged sector/event-risk/benchmark, i.e. exercising dormancy plus the empty/skip branches) continues to pass, proving no regression to the pre-C09 baseline.
